name: bespunky-product-ux
description: BeSpunky product & UX design — a pipeline from messy request to built UI: distill-the-brief (the real problem), envision-the-experience (the felt world), stage-the-vision (bold web-native art), mock-to-choose (concepts judged by eye), realize-the-vision (the researched build). Beside it: astonishing-to-use (the co-equal UX force), redesign-means-rethink (redesign from a blank canvas), keep-users-oriented (waits and steps), model-intent-not-data (intent in, decisions out).
